timezone.description: IANA time zone for "time" conditions, e.g. "Europe/Paris". Default "UTC".

max_tailwind.description: Maximum tailwind in kt, gusts included. Default 5.

max_crosswind.description: Maximum crosswind in kt, gusts included. Default 20.

lvo.description: Condition defining low-visibility operations. Default "rvr < 550 or visibility < 550 or ceiling < 200".

hysteresis_margin.description: Knots below the wind limits required to move back up to a better choice. Default 3.

lookahead_hours.description: Hours of forecast a better choice must stay usable for before switching to it. Default 2.

established_tailwind_hours.description: Hours a forecast tailwind must last before this choice gives way to one without tailwind. 0 disables. Default 3.

metar.description: Ordered METAR stations; the first fresh one is used. Default: the airport itself.

follow.description: Leader airport: this airport must face the same direction.

choice.description: Configurations by number: 1 is the first choice, the first usable one wins.

note.description: Free text shown with the decision.

runways.description: Runways for arrivals and departures. "05/23" = that runway facing into the wind, "23" = that direction only.

when.description: Condition for this choice, e.g. "time 22:00-06:00 and wind < 5".

max_tailwind.description: Tailwind limit for this choice, kt.

max_crosswind.description: Crosswind limit for this choice, kt.

established_tailwind_hours.description: Hours a forecast tailwind must last before this choice gives way to one without tailwind. 0 disables. Default 3.

unavailable.description: Runways that cannot be used, permanently, under a condition or between dates.

runways.description: Runway ends or pairs (a pair means both ends).

when.description: Unavailable while this condition holds, e.g. "lvo".
